scientific_integrity: The general claim is supported by a direct proof. A standalone exhaustive finite checker provides independent computational spot checks, not an infinite proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only labeled chores of uniform unit cost with complete bipartite item-conflict graph and inclusion-maximal feasible schedules; no general graph, valuation heterogeneity, strategic outcome, or Pareto-efficiency theorem. Prior equitable coloring formulas cover the complete coloring subproblem. The exact maximal-partial census and sharp half-completion gap have not been independently audited; publication-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Complete and maximal EF1 schedules on biclique conflict graphs: exact census and a sharp half-completion gap
